name: – Julien Sanchez – § 74 – Am 23
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 74. Expresses concern about recent reports of corruption cases, including allegations involving high-level officials in Ukraine, while acknowledging the progress made by Ukraine in advancing reforms on anti-corruption, anti-money laundering and accountability; highlights the fact that these efforts were undertaken by Ukraine in the midst of a fully fledged invasion; encourages Ukraine to continue its reforms, including efforts to address the influence of oligarchs, and calls on the Commission to further strengthen its oversight of EU-funded activities in the country;
